payload.title: Correlation Analysis in Pyleoclim
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook demonstrates the use of the Pyleoclim library for correlation analysis in paleoclimatology. It focuses on comparing age-uncertain records and computing correlations between records and gridded fields. The notebook utilizes various statistical methods, including Pearson's R, Spearman's ρ, and Kendall's τ, to assess correlations and significance. It also addresses the multiple comparisons problem and demonstrates the use of surrogate data for significance testing.
goals: Load and create age ensemble data
Run correlation workflow on ensembles using various statistics and surrogates
Interpret the results of correlation tests, especially with multiple tests
Convert between LiPD-formatted paleo data and Xarray datasets using pandas and Pyleoclim
